answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model by matching the predicted API call against the ground truth. For APIs that have strict value ranges for the arguments, we perform string matching on the respective arguments directly. For APIs that accept free natural language inputs, we use ChatGPT to judge the correctness of the predicted API arguments. We report the overall accuracy considering both API name and arguments (Correctness) as the main metric, together with the percentage of examples with valid API calls and no syntax/formatting errors (Wellformedness) and the percentage of examples that correctly choose to use the ground-truth API (API Match).
